records.body:
Hi Mia,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, River Studio!
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *River Studio* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week [email:8445165e], with no project, invite, or milestone after 6 days despite three outreach emails [email:ef3592c8, email:a4496d9a, email:374b46fc]. Stated deferral plus zero product activity makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely, though Team plan signals intent.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on River Studio's setup
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield fits River Studio. I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often helps the evaluation: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real piece of your work in Wrenfield tends to answer the "is this right for us" question faster than anything I could say.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 20-minute call this week and help you set up that first project with your actual work. Either way, just reply when you've decided.

Best,
Priya
